summary.text: Ian Diamondstone is the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party of Vermont candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windham-4 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was the party's candidate for lieutenant governor in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ian Diamondstone first appears on Ballotpedia as an independent candidate for Vermont House of Representatives Windham 2-3 in 2012, when he received 171 votes (11%) against Democrat Tristan Toleno.
As the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party of Vermont candidate for lieutenant governor, he received 8,159 votes (2.9%) in 2022 and 13,671 votes (3.9%) in 2024.
